# Setting Up

Data are loaded into the working environment. 
Export 1PM, 27th December 2025
Query: AFFILCOUNTRY(viet* AND jap*) 
Yielded 14,485 results
Refined query: AFFILCOUNTRY ( viet* AND jap* ) AND ( EXCLUDE ( PUBYEAR , 2026 ) ) AND ( LIMIT-TO ( DOCTYPE , "ar" ) ) AND ( LIMIT-TO ( PUBSTAGE , "final" ) ) AND ( LIMIT-TO ( SRCTYPE , "j" ) )
Yielded: 10,872 results


```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(text2sdg)

DATA_DIR <- "data"
FUNDER_DIR <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "data_funders")

# 1. LOAD RAW DATA
dat_raw <- read_csv(
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "all_1227.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_types = cols(.default = "c")
)

# 2. SELECT & RENAME COLUMNS
dat_reg <- dat_raw |>
  select(Year, "Source title", "Cited by", Affiliations, DOI, "Open Access", Abstract, "Correspondence Address") |>
  rename(
    year = Year,
    title = "Source title",
    cited = "Cited by",
    affiliations = Affiliations,
    open_access = "Open Access",
    abstract = Abstract,
    corr = "Correspondence Address"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    OA = if_else(!is.na(open_access) & open_access != "", 1L, 0L)
  ) |>
  select(-open_access) |>
  relocate(id, .before = 1)
```

# Journal-level data


```{r}
#| label: process-sources

dat_sources <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "sources_1227.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    rename(title = `Source Title`) |>
    arrange(title) |> 
    distinct(title, .keep_all = TRUE)

dat_sources <- dat_sources |>
  transmute(
    title,
    LS = `Top level:\n\nLife Sciences`,
    SS = `Top level:\n\nSocial Sciences`,
    PS = `Top level:\n\nPhysical Sciences`,
    HS = `Top level:\n\nHealth Sciences`,
    mult     = `1000 \nGeneral`,
    agr_bio  = `1100\nAgricultural and Biological Sciences`,
    arts     = `1200\nArts and Humanities`,
    bioch    = `1300\nBiochemistry, Genetics and Molecular Biology`,
    bus      = `1400\nBusiness, Management and Accounting`,
    chem_eng = `1500\nChemical Engineering`,
    chem     = `1600\nChemistry`,
    comp     = `1700\nComputer Science`,
    deci     = `1800\nDecision Sciences`,
    earth    = `1900\nEarth and Planetary Sciences`,
    econ     = `2000\nEconomics, Econometrics and Finance`,
    ener     = `2100\nEnergy`,
    engi     = `2200\nEngineering`,
    env      = `2300\nEnvironmental Science`,
    immu     = `2400\nImmunology and Microbiology`,
    mate     = `2500\nMaterials Science`,
    math     = `2600\nMathematics`,
    medi     = `2700\nMedicine`,
    neur     = `2800\nNeuroscience`,
    nurs     = `2900\nNursing`,
    phar     = `3000\nPharmacology, Toxicology and Pharmaceutics`,
    phys     = `3100\nPhysics and Astronomy`,
    psyc     = `3200\nPsychology`,
    soci     = `3300\nSocial Sciences`,
    vete     = `3400\nVeterinary`,
    dent     = `3500\nDentistry`,
    heal     = `3600\nHealth Professions`
  ) |>
  mutate(across(-title, ~ if_else(!is.na(.) & . != "", 1L, 0L))) |>
  distinct(title, .keep_all = TRUE)

sjr <- read_delim(file.path(DATA_DIR, "sjr_1227.csv"),delim = ";", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    filter(Type == "journal") |>
    select(Title, SJR, `SJR Best Quartile`) |>
    rename(
        title = Title,
        sjr_score = SJR,
        quartile = `SJR Best Quartile`
    ) |>
    mutate(
    sjr_score = parse_number(sjr_score, locale = locale(grouping_mark = ",")) / 1000,
    quartile = factor(quartile, levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"))
    ) |>
    distinct(title, .keep_all = TRUE)

dat_reg <- dat_reg |>
    left_join(dat_sources, by = "title") |>
    left_join(sjr, by = "title")
```

# Collaboration

```{r}
coop_type <- dat_reg |>
    transmute(id, affiliations, n_authors = str_count(affiliations, ";") + 1L) |>
    separate_rows(affiliations, sep = ";") |>
    mutate(
        affiliations = str_trim(affiliations),
        country = str_extract(affiliations, "[^,]+$") |>
        str_trim()
    ) |>
    distinct(id, country, n_authors) |>
    count(id, n_authors, name = "n_countries") |>
    mutate(
        coop = case_when(
            n_authors >= 100L ~ "hyperauthored",
            n_countries == 2L ~ "bilateral",
            n_countries > 2L ~ "multilateral",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
    ) |>
    select(id, n_authors, n_countries, coop)

dat_reg <- dat_reg |>
    left_join(coop_type, by = "id")
```

# Funding

```{r}
funder_files <- tribble(
    ~file, ~region, ~sector,
    "ja_ind.csv", "ja", "ind",
    "ja_pub.csv", "ja", "pub",
    "ja_aca.csv", "ja", "aca",
    "vn_pub.csv", "vn", "pub",
    "vn_aca.csv", "vn", "aca",
    "o_ind.csv", "o", "ind",
    "o_pub", "o", "pub",
    "o_aca", "o", "aca"
)

funder_data <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(funder_files)), function(i) {
    file_path <- file.path(FUNDER_DIR, funder_files$file[i])
        if (!file.exists(file_path)) return(tibble())
            read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
            select(DOI) |>
            mutate(
                !!funder_files$region[i] := 1L,
                !!funder_files$sector[i] := 1L
            )
        }) |>
    group_by(DOI) |>
    summarise(
    across(everything(), ~ as.integer(any(. == 1, na.rm = TRUE))),
    .groups = "drop"
    )

dat_reg <- dat_reg |>
    left_join(funder_data, by = "DOI") |>
    mutate(across(asian:vn, ~ replace_na(., 0L))) |>
    mutate(
        fund = as.integer(if_any(asian:vn, ~ . == 1L)),
        n_regions = asian + eu + int + jap + us + vn,
        n_sectors = ind + pub + uni,
        bilateral_funding = as.integer(jap == 1L & vn == 1L)
    )
```
